lens: quiet evidence-first hierarchy, state language, provenance, and visual restraint

findings.observation: The page gives the strongest top-level signal to execution status ok while the decisive semantic state needs_review appears later as one card among many passing checks.
findings.evidence: 03-trace-result.jpg shows the green ok status at the page header and semantic_outcome_quality as the third item in the evaluations section.
findings.user_impact: The surface visually promotes transport success over the unresolved judgment the evaluator actually needs to make.
findings.recommendation: Use one compact expected-to-observed decision seam: Execution passed, Semantic review required, one reason, and one next action; keep raw mechanics as supporting disclosure.
findings.verification: In a five-second test, builders identify the unresolved semantic judgment before quoting the execution status.

findings.observation: Raw identifiers, underscored evaluator names, full span attributes, and repeated card containers dominate the result instead of the case, mismatch, evidence, and next test.
findings.evidence: 03-trace-result.jpg is 4242px tall and 04-mobile-trace.jpg is 5903px tall for one run; most visible rows are passing mechanics or raw telemetry.
findings.user_impact: The user reconstructs the decision from infrastructure detail, making the product feel like a trace viewer rather than a calm Agent-quality workspace.
findings.recommendation: Translate machine names into short human labels, group passes into one collapsed receipt, preserve exact raw names in details, and let the vermilion seam connect expected behavior to the observed mismatch.
findings.verification: The default view contains one resting point, one unresolved judgment, and one next test while every raw identifier remains reachable in one disclosure.

strengths: The visual character is calm, neutral, restrained, and consistent with Talent Signal rather than generic AI-console styling.
Expected receipt, governed artifacts, tool order, provider capability, and external-effect state are all inspectable.
The design uses status text as well as color and avoids candidate scores or confidence theater.
missing_evidence: No five-second comprehension test, dark-mode review, localization expansion, or assistive-technology walkthrough.
No rendered comparison between the current ledger-first structure and an exception-first structural direction.
open_questions: Should the primary object be the Eval case verdict, with the Trace treated as its supporting receipt rather than the page title?
